description.p: NightPost is an email client for Gmail, iCloud and any IMAP account, written in Rust.

ul.li: One inbox for every account, with Primary, Promotions and Social tabs
Snooze and pin conversations, synced between your computers
Swipe a conversation to archive, trash, snooze or move it
HTML email with trackers blocked, and a formatted composer
A built-in MCP server, so an assistant can read your mail and save drafts for you to send
